name: Julissis Artemis Le Tibarni
original_name: ジュリシス・アルテミス・ル・ティバーニ
source:
A kindhearted girl who asked for the salvation of the Earthly Realm at a meeting of the Elyos, but was denied permission and so decided to stand up on her own. She is pure of heart who exudes elegance and dignity. However, she is a bit of an oddball among the Elyos...She considers her mission to be a duty imposed upon her, and attempts to carry out the mission without any regrets. She also believes that others should act out of a sense of duty, so she cannot hide her confusion at Anduke's selfish behavior.

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20071207110423fw_/http://www.mink.co.jp/lineup/da/char02.html]Mink[/url]]
